formation.explanation: Append is proposal admission: followers forward or buffer, leaders buffer in Prepare or append in Accept. A new leader gathers sender-indexed promises, selects the maximum accepted history and maximum reported decision index, synchronizes storage, then sends AcceptSync. Followers acknowledge synchronized or appended log indices. The leader counts per-sender accepted indices for its ballot and advances decisions when the configured write quorum supports an index. Decide/AcceptDecide propagate the index; public reads distinguish Decided from Undecided and applications consume the former.

context.explanation: BLE uses heartbeat rounds and configuration-tagged ballots to select leadership. SequencePaxos independently requires a ballot higher than its existing leader and promise. A local leader resets volatile quorum accounting and persists its promise; a receiving follower persists a higher promise and enters Prepare. Accept processing requires the promised ballot and appropriate phase, and ordered messages use session/counter sequence numbers. Older requests are rejected or ignored; higher unexpected accepts and sequence gaps initiate recovery. Persisted promises start recovery after reconstruction. NotAccepted marks a peer as having promised higher.

connection.explanation: Authority is insufficient without prepare support: prior accepted rounds and lengths determine the history installed in the new ballot, while prior decisions constrain the reported decision prefix. Buffered proposals are incorporated after history selection unless a StopSign is present; follower synchronization forwards buffered proposals if not stopped. Old-ballot acknowledgments cannot advance a new leader because accepted handlers require matching ballots and leader state is reset. Recovery reuses equal-ballot Prepare only in Recover and starts a new accept sequence session. StopSign travels with synchronized history and stops new local admission; starting the next configuration and carrying application history is a documented caller duty.
